reviews.title: Une forme de spiritualité
reviews.text: Je suis positivement consciente que les choses, énergies qui nous entourent (planètes, étoiles, énergies de l’univers) nous affectent, nous influencent… je vous encourage à découvrir tout comme moi pour répondre à de la curiosité humaine et qui parfois, peut être, nous aide  dans nos moments de doute ou questionnement
reviews.reply: Thank you for the beautiful reflection 🌙 We’re grateful Nebula could feel like a gentle companion in moments of curiosity and doubt. With gratitude, Nebula Team 🔮

reviews.title: scam
reviews.reply:
Dear User, hello there!
We are very sorry to hear that our app didn’t meet your expectations and that you had payment issues. We apologize for any confusion!
If you have received a bank payment notification on the website, it means that you have activated automatic renewal. You confirm the automatic subscription renewal during the first payment for the Premium Subscription or Compatibility Report along with the Premium Subscription.
We provide this information on our sales page, payment screen, and Subscription terms. Also, in the Subscription Terms, it is clearly stated how to cancel the website subscription.
You can tell us more detail about the issue at support@nebulahoroscope.com, we will do our best to help you with this concern.
Have a nice day, Nebula team.
